newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says no comment on PNB buy talk.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says no comment on PNB buy talk.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) on Thursday said it had no comment on reports it was interested in buying a stake in PNB-Republic Bank, a unit of Philippine National Bank (PNB).
"We have no comment as is the policy with issues of that nature," a NAB spokesman told Reuters.
Earlier, PNB president Peter Favila told reporters in Manila NAB was among eight groups interested in buying the 60 percent stake in PNB-Republic which is up for auction.

Last month NAB managing director Don Argus said the bank, which is Australia's largest in terms of assets and profits, remained on the lookout for acquisitions in Asia, the United Kingdom and United States.
At 2315 GMT (10.17 a.m.), NAB shares were up eight cents to A$14.96.
